fusions.name: Skyfall Stamp
fusions.desc: A leaping stamp on a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to twice that at full reach. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Riders Take Wing
fusions.desc: Sends 3 oxpeckers off your back at once, spread apart, each dealing 2 damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Over the Moon
fusions.desc: A bounding leap that carries you 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Perched Egret
fusions.desc: A bonded egret rides on your back and darts at enemies within 4 tiles, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.
